notes.title: New Prologue Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Here are some fixes/changes made to the prologue:

- Simpler UI for in game options.
- New Inventory menu ( Easier to use/see all your items at once )
- New walk/run animations for Ash
- New fake lighting added to the game
- Removed custom controls from the options menu as it was causing the game to soft lock


I'm aware of the numerous grammatical mistakes/spelling errors and will be hiring a few editors before the full game releases, Please pardon/report any you find in the community forums here on steam. Thank you :)

notes.title: Resolution fixed to 1080p!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Here's a few updates I made whilst working on the beta:

- Fixed the resolution to 1080p!
- Fixed more dialogue and grammar issues
- Added small wait time when opening dialogue options to not selected the first answer 
   for key mashers.
- Removed the option for the old dialogue box ( doesn't fit well with 1080p )
- Fixed some other minor bugs.

notes.title: Update v1.4
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Just a quick update.

I've spent the last few days fixing the dialogue and text as I think I will be making the original text box.
Here are the fixes:

[list]
[*]Altered most of the dialogue to sound more casual than formal.
[*] Edited dialogue in Shiruta to help set the scene of a human appearing in the spirit world.  
[*] No story elements have been changes 
[*] Fixed a lot of grammatical/ spellings errors (Sorry everyone)
[*] Fixed being able to get a soda in Shiruta as it serves no purpose. 
[*]Added a little more interesting dialogue throughout the prologue
[/list]

notes.title: Added Keyboard Mapping!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

I've seen some fantastic feedback lately! Thank you to all those who have contributed!

[/list]
